title: Coatue Negotiates First Multibillion Dollar VC JV With MatX for Chip Capacity
summary:
Logic dies and memory chips will be the focus of a new partnership between Coatue and MatX to bypass hardware supply constraints. The joint venture is in discussions to be funded with billions of dollars to finance purchases at semiconductor foundries for the startup.

The agreement includes securing production capacity at TSMC to help the company compete in a constrained AI hardware market. This first-of-its-kind arrangement sees a venture capital firm directly financing chip components and manufacturing access to ensure MatX secures the necessary hardware for its operations.
